blurb: Guests experience a private hot air balloon flight lasting about 50-60 minutes, flying at altitudes from just above treetops to around 3,000 feet. Flights occur in the early morning or late afternoon under calm and stable weather conditions. The entire experience lasts approximately 3 hours including meeting, safety briefing, transport, flight, landing, and post-flight celebration.
